page.overview:
Who is British Knight?

The British Knight is a minor character in Invincible. He was a superhero who lived in the United Kingdom until his death at the hands of an Invincible variant during the Invincible War.

British Knight had grey armor around his body with horns on his helmet, spikes on his shoulders, light red gem on his chest and dark green cloth around his waist.

The British Knight's history is unknown. At some point he becomes superhero and worked with the Global Defense Agency where he protected his home country: the United Kingdom.

During the funeral of the Guardians of the Globe he was seen during the Eulogy of Omni-Man.
